messages:
emily_cs: Heads-up: OrionMed pilot reported slower search results. Our telemetry shows embeddings p95 ~380ms (commit 250ms) and availability 99.89%. Renewal check in 3 weeks. Need rapid CS+Eng+Sales plan + proposed customer note.

marc_eng: Looking. Early trace shows regional warmup misses during bursts. Suspect batching + prewarm.

ops_bot: Alert: slo/embeddings p95 breach (last 24h). Dashboard: https://grafana.internal.redwood/d/embeddings

rachel_sales: Customer cares about UX. If we canshow mitigation and timeline, renewal should be OK. Consider a goodwill credit.

lina_cs_manager: Playbook: 1) Eng canary a batching/prewarm tweak (owner: marc_eng) 2) CS draft empathetic note + usage snapshot (owner: emily_cs) 3) Ops capture before/after metrics (owner: ops_bot) 4) Sales align on renewal messaging and credit ask (owner: rachel_sales).

emily_cs: I'll draft comms after canary. Proposed offset: 5% of monthly usage per internal guidance if canary shows short-term improvement.

marc_eng: Canary ready in ~4h. Quick fix reduces batch_max and increases prewarm.

ops_bot: Canary run started; monitoring p95 and availability.

rachel_sales: Send draft to me before external send. Keep credit simple (one-off), note remediation in renewal pack.

emily_cs: Added to account health and renewal tracker. Will update thread after canary results.

marc_eng: ETA canary results ~4.5h, will post metrics then.

lina_cs_manager: Thanks team. Marking renewal risk as "monitoring" until post-canary stability.
